note: Live-session recording (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Passwords are never in this file: the owner types the connection string once when prepare asks (Server=10.50.0.30,1433;Database=master;UID=<login>;<the login's password entry>;Encrypt=yes;TrustServerCertificate=yes); prepare keeps it in the MG_SQL_BASE variable of this session and derives SQL_CONNECTION_STRING for each database; teardown removes both. T-SQL set-up runs on CON-SQL01 over PowerShell Direct as the lab Administrator with Windows authentication (SQL Server's own sysadmin group is Domain Admins). Episode login: lab_demo (created once, off camera, as in this episode's demo.md); prepare stops with a clear message if it is missing.
prepare: $sql = { param($vm, $text) Invoke-Command -VMName $vm -Credential $cred -ArgumentList $text -ScriptBlock { param($t) $c = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection 'Server=localhost;Integrated Security=SSPI;TrustServerCertificate=True'; $c.Open(); try { foreach ($b in ($t -split '(?im)^\s*GO\s*$')) { if ($b.Trim()) { $m = $c.CreateCommand(); $m.CommandText = $b; $m.CommandTimeout = 600; [void]$m.ExecuteNonQuery() } } } finally { $c.Close() } } }
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF SUSER_ID(N'lab_demo') IS NULL THROW 50000, N'Create the login lab_demo first (episode 3 demo.md, setup step 3; owner types its password off camera).', 1;"

& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "GRANT VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE TO lab_demo;`nGO`nUSE ContosoBikesPerf;`nGO`nIF USER_ID(N'lab_demo') IS NULL CREATE USER lab_demo FOR LOGIN lab_demo;`nALTER ROLE db_owner ADD MEMBER lab_demo;"
if (-not $env:MG_SQL_BASE) { $env:MG_SQL_BASE = Read-Host 'Connection string for lab_demo on 10.50.0.30,1433 (typed off camera, never saved; format in the note of record.json)' -MaskInput }

screens.name: q01-plans
steps: Open SSMS 22 and connect to 10.50.0.30,1433 with SQL Server Authentication as lab_demo (secret typed off camera, Remember off); in Options > Connection Properties set the database to ContosoBikesPerf and tick Trust server certificate (lab only)
Open src/sql/ix00-drop-lab-indexes.sql and run it; open src/sql/q01-customer-orders.sql, turn on Include Actual Execution Plan (Ctrl+M) and run it
Plan 1: Clustered Index Scan (PK_Orders) + Sort; keep the green Missing Index text if SSMS shows one
Open and run src/sql/ix01-customer.sql, then run q01 again: plan 2 shows Index Seek (IX_Orders_CustomerId) + Nested Loops + Key Lookup (PK_Orders) + Sort
Show both plans (two windows side by side or stacked); hover the Key Lookup so the tooltip shows Number of Executions 7

teardown: $sql = { param($vm, $text) Invoke-Command -VMName $vm -Credential $cred -ArgumentList $text -ScriptBlock { param($t) $c = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection 'Server=localhost;Integrated Security=SSPI;TrustServerCertificate=True'; $c.Open(); try { foreach ($b in ($t -split '(?im)^\s*GO\s*$')) { if ($b.Trim()) { $m = $c.CreateCommand(); $m.CommandText = $b; $m.CommandTimeout = 600; [void]$m.ExecuteNonQuery() } } } finally { $c.Close() } } }
& $sql 'CON-SQL01' "IF DB_ID(N'ContosoBikesPerf') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER DATABASE ContosoBikesPerf SET SINGLE_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE; DROP DATABASE ContosoBikesPerf; END"
